description: Preserve explicit zero stars through cleanTav. Existing 1..5 ranks remain unchanged; missing or invalid legacy ranks retain default 1. Initial summon grants and duplicate transactions are not changed by this patch.

edits.name: Allow a saved zero without downgrading existing ranks
edits.new: st = Math.min(5, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(+c.k) && c.k !== null && c.k !== '' ? Math.round(+c.k) : 1))
